title: A BEMD-Based Quaternion Filtering Approach Sharp-to-Soft Kernel CT Image Conversion
title_zh: 基于BEMD的Quaternion滤波方法：从锐核到软核的CT图像转换

paragraphs.en: The quality of computed tomography (CT) images is significantly affected by the selection of reconstruction kernels: sharp kernels improve spatial resolution but increase noise, whereas soft kernels diminish noise at the expense of edge clarity. This study presents an innovative enhancement framework utilising Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition in conjunction with Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (BEMD–QBF) to convert sharp-kernel CT images into representations resembling soft-kernels, while maintaining critical anatomical structures. The technique disaggregates each image into intrinsic mode functions via BEMD and analyzes them inside a cohesive quaternion framework to attain efficient noise reduction and structural integrity. The proposed methodology is evaluated using several reconstruction kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36, B35, B31) and compared with recognised filtering strategies, including Non-Local Means, Anisotropic Diffusion, Bilateral Filtering, and Quaternion Bilateral Filtering. Quantitative evaluations of the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) indicate that BEMD-QBF consistently attains superior structural fidelity and competitive noise reduction across all evaluated kernels. The results underscore the efficacy of the proposed strategy as a viable approach to enhancing post-reconstruction CT images, yielding superior image quality without requiring access to raw projection data.

paragraphs.en: Computed tomography (CT) is fundamental to contemporary medical imaging, providing intricate cross-sectional views of internal anatomical structures by combining X-ray projections with advanced computer reconstruction algorithms. The selection of the reconstruction filter, generally known as the convolution kernel, is a crucial determinant of the diagnostic quality of CT images. This kernel balances spatial resolution and noise, and its choice is generally customised to the tissue properties and clinical objectives involved [ 1 , 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 计算机断层扫描（CT）是现代医学成像的基础，它通过将X射线投影与先进的计算机重建算法相结合，提供内部解剖结构的精细横截面图像。 重建滤波器的选择（通常称为卷积核）是决定CT图像诊断质量的关键因素。 该卷积核在空间分辨率和噪声之间取得平衡，其选择通常会根据相关组织的特性和临床目标进行定制 [ 1 , 2 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Soft reconstruction kernels are engineered to attenuate noise, making them particularly effective for imaging low-contrast areas such as the brain, mediastinum, or abdominal organs, where nuanced tissue distinctions require unambiguous visualisation. In contrast, sharp kernels improve spatial resolution and enhance the visibility of intricate anatomical details, making them advantageous in high-contrast regions such as bone or lung parenchyma. Nonetheless, this enhancement in edge definition introduces increased noise, which may complicate subsequent image analysis and interpretation [ 3 , 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 软重建核函数经过专门设计，能够衰减噪声，因此对于成像低对比度区域（如大脑、纵隔或腹部器官）尤为有效，因为这些区域的细微组织差异需要清晰明确的可视化呈现。 相比之下，锐利核函数能提升空间分辨率并增强复杂解剖细节的可见性，因此在高对比度区域（如骨骼或肺实质）更具优势。 然而，这种边缘定义的提升也会引入更多噪声，可能使后续的图像分析与解读变得复杂 [ 3 , 4 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A recurring issue arises when the reconstruction kernel used during image acquisition is inadequate for subsequent diagnostic or computational applications. Retrospective alteration of the kernel is challenging because it requires access to the original projection data, which is typically not preserved due to the substantial storage requirements. Clinical procedures emphasise efficiency by storing only the reconstructed images in Image Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS), thereby limiting the ability to alter reconstruction parameters during post-processing [ 5 ] . This method preserves storage resources but limits the possibilities for kernel adaptation in subsequent applications [ 6 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当图像采集过程中使用的重建核不适用于后续的诊断或计算应用时，会反复出现一个问题。 事后更改重建核具有挑战性，因为这需要访问原始投影数据，而由于存储需求巨大，这些数据通常不会被保留。 临床流程强调效率，因此仅将重建后的图像存储在影像归档与通信系统（PACS）中，从而限制了在后期处理过程中调整重建参数的可能性 [ 5 ] 。 这种方法虽然节省了存储资源，但也限制了在后续应用中调整重建核的可能性 [ 6 , 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA), Siemens scanners often utilise kernels like B26f for soft-tissue imaging and B46f for medium-sharp reconstruction. The B26f kernel effectively reduces noise but degrades edge clarity, making it less suitable for tasks requiring accurate structural demarcation. The B46f kernel improves the visibility of calcifications and stents but introduces significant noise, which may impede automated processing methods such as segmentation or active contour modelling [ 8 , 9 ] . In these situations, the ability to transform images reconstructed with sharp kernels into representations akin to soft-kernel outputs—without access to the raw data—would greatly enhance diagnostic adaptability and computational efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 在冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管造影（CCTA）中，西门子扫描仪通常使用 B26f 等核函数进行软组织成像，并使用 B46f 进行中等清晰度的重建。 B26f 核函数能有效减少噪声，但会降低边缘清晰度，因此不太适合需要精确结构界定的任务。 B46f 核函数能增强钙化和支架的可见性，但会引入显著噪声，这可能阻碍分割或活动轮廓建模等自动化处理方法 [8, 9]。 在这种情况下，若能将使用清晰核函数重建的图像转换为类似于软核函数输出的表示形式——而无需访问原始数据——将极大提升诊断适应性和计算效率。

paragraphs.en: Despite the proposal of several post-reconstruction improvement techniques, many traditional filtering methods fail to achieve an appropriate balance between noise reduction and edge preservation. These approaches often oversmooth critical structures or fail to adequately suppress noise. This paper presents a hybrid framework that utilises Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition (BEMD) to adaptively decompose CT images into intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and then applies a quaternion bilateral filter to the selected components. BEMD provides a data-driven multiscale representation of the image, whilst the quaternion bilateral filter facilitates edge-preserving smoothing within a cohesive quaternionic color space. Collectively, these methods enable the conversion of sharp-kernel images into outputs resembling soft-kernel images, preserving structural integrity without necessitating access to raw projection data.

Section 2 reviews the relevant literature on CT image denoising, reconstruction kernel transformation, and decomposition-based augmentation techniques. Section 3 delineates the proposed methodology, detailing the integration of BEMD with quaternion bilateral filtering to enhance CT images. Section 4 delineates the experimental configuration, including dataset attributes, implementation details, and evaluation metrics. paragraphs.en: Improving CT image quality has been a persistent objective in medical imaging research, particularly due to the trade-off between noise reduction and structural integrity imposed by different reconstruction kernels. Sharp kernels are frequently employed to visualise high-contrast objects such as bone or calcifications due to their exceptional edge definition. This benefit, however, is coupled with increased noise, complicating the evaluation of low-contrast tissues such as the brain or the mediastinum. Consequently, post-reconstruction denoising has become crucial for mitigating noise introduced by sharp kernels while preserving diagnostically significant anatomical details [ 10 , 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 提升 CT 图像质量一直是医学影像研究中的一个持续目标，尤其是因为不同的重建核会在降噪与结构完整性之间产生权衡。 由于锐利核具有出色的边缘定义能力，因此常被用于可视化高对比度物体，例如骨骼或钙化灶。 然而，这种优势也伴随着噪声的增加，使得对大脑或纵隔等低对比度组织的评估变得复杂。 因此，重建后的降噪处理对于减轻锐利核引入的噪声，同时保留具有诊断意义的重要解剖细节而言，已变得至关重要 [ 10 , 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Conventional denoising techniques have been extensively investigated to enhance CT images. The Non-Local Means (NLM) filter [ 12 , 13 ] mitigates noise by averaging analogous pixel neighbourhoods, while successfully preserving edges, but it frequently struggles with intricate structural features in areas of high noise. The Anisotropic Diffusion (AD) filter [ 14 , 15 ] utilises gradient-driven diffusion to refine uniform regions while preserving edges. Notwithstanding their advantages, both NLM and AD may produce blurring artefacts or fail to adequately preserve fine anatomical details in demanding noise environments.

paragraphs.en: The Bilateral Filter (BF) [ 16 , 17 ] is a widely used method that achieves edge-preserving smoothing by integrating spatial and intensity similarities. QBF has shown enhanced efficacy in maintaining edge definition and colour uniformity; nevertheless, its performance may diminish when confronted with intricate noise patterns characteristic of CT imaging.

paragraphs.en: Decomposition-based approaches have attracted increased interest for their ability to distinguish noise from significant structural elements. Methods such as Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) and its multidimensional variants have been utilised in medical imaging to extract intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) that represent various frequency components [ 19 , 20 ] . These techniques provide targeted denoising by manipulating specific intrinsic mode functions (IMFs). Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition (BEMD) has evolved as a robust, entirely data-driven method that can adaptively decompose images without the need for specified basis functions. Its multiscale nature makes it particularly suitable for isolating noise-dominated components while preserving structural information.

paragraphs.en: In addition to traditional filtering and decomposition, deep learning methods have been investigated for modifying reconstruction kernels. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been employed to transform CT images reconstructed with a single kernel into representations that mimic those of different kernels, even without the original projection data [ 5 ] . Additional research has explored point spread function (PSF)-based filtering to replicate various reconstruction kernels [ 21 ] . Sparse representation approaches have shown promise, with dictionary-based models achieving significant advances in low-dose CT denoising while preserving critical anatomical information [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 除了传统的滤波和分解方法外，研究人员还探索了利用深度学习方法来修改重建核。 卷积神经网络（CNN）已被用于将使用单一核重建的CT图像转换为模拟不同核重建结果的表示形式，即使没有原始投影数据也能实现 [ 5 ] 。 其他研究则探索了基于点扩散函数（PSF）的滤波方法，以复现不同的重建核 [ 21 ] 。 稀疏表示方法展现出良好前景，其中基于字典的模型在低剂量CT去噪方面取得了显著进展，同时保留了关键的解剖学信息 [ 22 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Despite these developments, current approaches sometimes struggle to simultaneously achieve robust noise suppression, edge preservation, and adaptability across various reconstruction kernels. This paper presents a hybrid architecture that combines Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition (BEMD) with bilateral quaternion filtering to overcome these limitations. BEMD facilitates an adaptive multiscale decomposition of CT images into intrinsic mode functions, while the quaternion bilateral filter applies edge-preserving smoothing to selected components within a cohesive quaternionic framework. This combination facilitates the efficient conversion of sharp-kernel images into outputs resembling soft-kernel images without requiring raw projection data.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，当前的方法有时仍难以同时实现稳健的噪声抑制、边缘保留以及在不同重建核之间的适应性。 本文提出了一种混合架构，将二维经验模态分解（BEMD）与双边四元数滤波相结合，以克服上述局限性。 BEMD 能够将 CT 图像自适应地分解为多个尺度的本征模态函数，而四元数双边滤波器则在一个连贯的四元数框架内对选定的分量进行边缘保留平滑处理。 这种组合使得无需原始投影数据，即可将锐利核图像高效地转换为类似于软核图像的输出。

paragraphs.en: This study utilises a dataset of clinical CT scans obtained with a Siemens SOMATOM Definition Flash scanner. paragraphs.en: This section provides a thorough assessment of the proposed BEMD–QBF improvement approach against four prevalent filtering techniques: Bilateral Filtering (BF), Non-Local Means (NLM), Anisotropic Diffusion (AD), and Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (QBF). paragraphs.en: The integrated SSIM and PSNR outcomes underscore the resilience of the proposed BEMD–QBF methodology. SSIM values indicate that structural information is well preserved, whereas PSNR values reflect efficient noise reduction. Compared with classical filters (BF, NLM, AD) and standalone quaternion-based filtering (QBF), BEMD–QBF consistently yields significant improvements in both perceptual quality and quantitative accuracy. The primary benefit of BEMD–QBF is its adaptive decomposition of the image into intrinsic mode functions, which facilitates selective denoising of high-frequency components while preserving low-frequency anatomical structures. The quaternion-bilateral filter further refines this technique by concurrently smoothing all components inside a single 4-D representation, thereby providing coherent edge retention and enhanced noise suppression.
paragraphs.zh: 综合 SSIM 和 PSNR 的结果凸显了所提出的 BEMD–QBF 方法的稳健性。 SSIM 值表明结构信息得到了良好保留，而 PSNR 值则反映了高效的降噪效果。 与经典滤波器（BF、NLM、AD）以及独立的四元数滤波方法（QBF）相比，BEMD–QBF 在感知质量和定量准确性方面始终表现出显著改进。 BEMD–QBF 的主要优势在于其将图像自适应分解为内在模式函数，从而能够选择性去除高频成分，同时保留低频的解剖结构。 四元数双边滤波器通过在一个统一的四维表示中同步平滑所有成分，进一步优化了这一技术，从而实现了连贯的边缘保留和更有效的噪声抑制。

paragraphs.en: This research presented an innovative CT image enhancement framework that combines Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition (BEMD) with Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (QBF) to convert sharp-kernel reconstructions into representations resembling soft kernels. The BEMD–QBF approach significantly diminishes noise and preserves critical anatomical structures by decomposing each image into intrinsic mode functions and storing them in a single quaternion domain.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究提出了一种创新的CT图像增强框架，该框架将二维经验模态分解（BEMD）与四元数双边滤波（QBF）相结合，从而将锐核重建转换为类似于软核的表示形式。 BEMD–QBF方法通过将每幅图像分解为内在模态函数并将其存储于单一的四元数域中，显著减少了噪声并保留了关键的解剖结构。

The PSNR results further confirmed the method’s efficacy in noise suppression while preserving image quality, particularly for kernels with moderate noise levels, such as B46. These findings underscore the resilience and versatility of the proposed methodology in various reconstruction settings.

paragraphs.en: Notwithstanding its good performance, numerous limitations persist. This study focuses exclusively on CT imaging, necessitating potential modifications for other modalities such as MRI or ultrasound due to variations in noise characteristics and structural patterns. Moreover, while computational efficiency was satisfactory for the data set used, further optimization may be required for extensive clinical implementation or real-time applications.

paragraphs.en: Future studies will investigate the expansion of the BEMD–QBF architecture to encompass new imaging modalities and the incorporation of adaptive parameter selection algorithms, potentially informed by machine learning. These enhancements may promote generalizability and diminish the need for human adjustment. In addition, assessing the approach within comprehensive clinical workflows—such as automated diagnostic or radiomic pipelines—could yield a better understanding of its practical utility and clinical significance.
